title: 第674章 老神仙日常674第673章 老神仙日常673第三世 秩序 林彦廷＆韩烈
content_zh:
从心理学上来讲，其实韩烈是个标准的好孩子，他听话、成绩优异、情绪稳定……
可是，林彦廷心中知道他不是个好孩子，是一个伪装成“好孩子”的“坏孩子”。
这个“坏孩子”将所有都压抑在了心中，林彦廷知道他在等待，等待一个情绪的爆发点，却没想到这孩子对世界的反应会是如此激烈。
他和韩烈，他们相识于两年前。
两年来，这个伪装得很好的“坏孩子”除了惹他生气，给他找麻烦，似乎没有什么值得留恋的地方，可他却……
想着，林彦廷轻轻摇了摇头，他心中承认，韩烈是个极有魅力的“坏孩子”。
“林
sir，好巧，没想到会在这里看见你。”
林彦廷眉梢微挑，故意顿了顿方才扭头去看，“madam
唐，真是巧。”
唐萱想要露出个笑来，可半天也只是深吸了一口气，轻轻点了点头，“你和他是朋友。”
这句话并不是疑问句，这种肯定的语气让林彦廷勾唇浅笑。
他没说话，伸手去摸了摸墓碑顶端。
将手掌搭在了墓碑上，他转眸对唐萱露出个笑来。
在林彦廷心中，这姓唐的madam是个粗心的“犯错者”。
她并不是一个合格的警察，头脑一根筋，查案也只凭直觉，许多线索在她眼前白白丢掉，还有许多案情被透露也是因为她的不严谨和习惯性依赖……
“林
sir，”唐萱回了个笑，“今天天气不错。”
林彦廷点了点头，俯身去拿墓碑旁边的啤酒。
韩烈一直说想和他喝一杯，可惜，他不能喝酒。

轻呼出一口气，他从口袋里拿出了自己家的门钥匙，一搭一起，瓶盖飞了出去。
“你……”唐萱欲言又止，朝前走了两步，将那飞出去的瓶盖捡了回来，她伸手递了过去。
林彦廷掀起眼皮看了一眼那瓶盖，仍是不言语，只是用下巴点了点墓碑前的空地。
唐萱抿着唇，将手中的瓶盖丢在了那块空地上。
收回手时，她将双手抱在了胸前，决定不再与眼前这个不知从哪里冒出来的警局特别顾问客气，“是你给他收的尸。”
林彦廷将手中啤酒倒了一半在墓碑前面，另半瓶，他握在自己掌中，就蹲在韩烈墓碑前，一口一口喝了起来。
唐萱皱紧了眉头，她咬紧了后槽牙，“你们究竟是什么关系？”
林彦廷抬眸又看了一眼唐萱，勾唇露出个浅笑来。
“你就是为了他？！”唐萱喘了两口粗气，“为了给他报仇，所以就来整我？！让我停职，你知不知道，好港每日有多少案件，你停了我的职，这些案件谁来处理？！”
林彦廷哼笑了一声，仰头将瓶中酒一饮而尽，起身时轻轻摸了摸墓碑上韩烈的名字。
content_en:
Psychologically speaking, Han Lie is actually a standard good boy. He is obedient, has excellent grades, and is emotionally stable...
However, Lin Yanting knew in his heart that he was not a good boy, but a "bad boy" pretending to be a "good boy".
This "bad boy" suppressed everything in his heart. Lin Yanting knew that he was waiting for an emotional breaking point, but he did not expect that this child's reaction to the world would be so violent.
He and Han Lie met two years ago.
In the past two years, this well-disguised "bad boy" seemed to have nothing to cherish except making him angry and causing him trouble, but he...
Thinking about it, Lin Yanting shook his head slightly, and he admitted in his heart that Han Lie was a very charming "bad boy".
"Lin
Sir, what a coincidence, I didn’t expect to see you here. "
Lin Yanting raised his eyebrows slightly and paused deliberately before turning his head to look, "Madam
Tang, what a coincidence. "
Tang Xuan wanted to smile, but for a long time she just took a deep breath and nodded gently, "You and him are friends."
This sentence was not a question. This affirmative tone made Lin Yanting curl his lips and smile.
He didn't say anything, but reached out and touched the top of the tombstone.
Putting his palm on the tombstone, he turned his eyes and smiled at Tang Xuan.
In Lin Yanting's mind, Madam Tang was a careless "mistaker."
She is not a qualified police officer. She is single-minded and only relies on intuition when investigating cases. Many clues were thrown away in front of her eyes, and many cases were revealed because of her lack of rigor and habitual reliance...
"Lin
Sir," Tang Xuan smiled back, "The weather is nice today. "
Lin Yanting nodded and leaned over to get the beer next to the tombstone.
Han Lie kept saying that he wanted to have a drink with him, but unfortunately, he couldn't drink.
With a soft breath, he took out his house key from his pocket, and when they were put together, the bottle cap flew out.
"You..." Tang Xuan hesitated, took two steps forward, picked up the bottle cap that flew out, and handed it over.
Lin Yanting raised his eyelids and glanced at the bottle cap. Still silent, he just tapped the open space in front of the tombstone with his chin.
Tang Xuan pursed her lips and threw the bottle cap in her hand on the open space.
When she retracted her hand, she clasped her hands in front of her chest and decided not to be polite to the special adviser of the police station who appeared out of nowhere in front of her. "You collected the body for him."
Lin Yanting poured half of the beer in his hand in front of the tombstone. He held the other half in his palm, squatted in front of Han Lie's tombstone, and drank it one sip after another.
Tang Xuan frowned and clenched her molars, "What is your relationship?"
Lin Yanting raised his eyes and glanced at Tang Xuan again, curling his lips into a slight smile.
"Are you doing it for him?!" Tang Xuan took a deep breath, "In order to avenge him, you came to punish me?! Suspend me. Do you know how many cases there are in Hong Kong every day? If you suspend me, who will handle these cases?!"
Lin Yanting chuckled, raised his head and drank the wine in the bottle. When he stood up, he gently touched Han Lie's name on the tombstone.
